description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-E score (%) for different Large Language Models (LLMs) under varying conditions related to a technique called “SFT”. The horizontal axis represents the LLM, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B”, “LLaMA-2-13B”, and “LLaMA-2-70B” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-E (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each LLM category has a set of four stacked bars representing different conditions: “no SFT” (light yellow), “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (dark purple). For LLaMA-2-7B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 5, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 28, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 34, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 41.  For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 30, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 36, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 42, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 48. For LLaMA-2-70B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 25, the “+ SFT on D₀” bar reaches approximately 38, the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bar reaches approximately 44, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bar reaches approximately 49. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each LLM, with each condition stacked on top of the previous one, showing the cumulative effect of adding SFT on increasing datasets. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
